description: This file defines a class 'ListDevices' responsible for loading, displaying, and managing device lists (disks, LVM, RAID, Btrfs, Stratis) in a GUI application, including handling user selection and updating views.

classes.name: ListDevices
classes.description: Class for managing and displaying device lists in a GUI, including loading disks, group devices, handling selection, and updating views.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes ListDevices with a reference to the GUI, sets up selection signals.

methods.name: load_devices
methods.description: Loads and refreshes the list of devices, including disks and group devices.

methods.name: load_disks
methods.description: Loads disk devices, filtering based on installer mode, and adds them to the device list.

methods.name: load_group_devices
methods.description: Loads group devices such as LVM, RAID, Btrfs, and Stratis pools, and adds them to the device list.

methods.name: update_devices_view
methods.description: Refreshes the device view, maintaining selection if possible.

methods.name: select_device_by_name
methods.description: Selects a device in the list by its name.

methods.name: on_disk_selection_changed
methods.description: Handles user selection changes, ensuring valid selection and updating related views.
